args.content:
Packing List for Hawaii Vacation

Based on the vacation itinerary for Hawaii (June 10-20, 2024), here is the essential packing list:

Essential Items:
- Swimwear (for beach days, snorkeling, and kayaking)
- Sunscreen (essential for all outdoor activities)
- Hiking gear (for Diamond Head hike)
- Casual outfits (for shopping, dining, and general activities)
- Camera (to capture memories at all locations)
- Travel documents (passport, tickets, reservations)

Activity-Specific Items:
- Beach towel and beach bag
- Snorkeling gear (optional - can be rented)
- Hiking shoes or sturdy sandals
- Light rain jacket
- Comfortable walking shoes
- Formal outfit for Luau experience

Additional Recommendations:
- Sunglasses and hat
- Insect repellent
- First aid kit
- Portable charger for electronics
- Reusable water bottle
